usage_boundary: Adapt roles, authority, risk levels and service times before use. These templates are not legal requirements, accredited certifications, universal organization designs or disclosures of any company's internal process.

legend.A: Accountable: owns the outcome and final decision

activities.activity: Define or update a critical standard
Convert the standard into training and assessment
Execute the standard in the store
Analyze recurrence and approve system change

steps.name: Detect and classify
steps.exit_criterion: Deviation and provisional risk level recorded

steps.name: Capture evidence
steps.exit_criterion: Location, time, standard reference and field proof attached

steps.name: Assign owner and deadline
steps.exit_criterion: One accountable owner accepts an organization-defined deadline

steps.name: Contain immediate risk
steps.exit_criterion: Unsafe or material exposure is controlled before normal operation continues

steps.name: Verify effectiveness
steps.exit_criterion: Assigned verifier confirms the acceptance criterion in the field

steps.name: Analyze recurrence and prevent
steps.exit_criterion: Recurring or systemic issues trigger root-cause and system action

items: Role and task scope are defined
Critical outcomes, behaviors and conditions are observable
Risk-critical errors and escalation rules are understood
Evidence and assessor identity are recorded
The decision is pass, conditional deployment or retraining
Post-deployment verification and renewal triggers are scheduled
